input.label: bug
input.reply: Thanks for the minimal repro. A module namespace that exports `then` is treated as a thenable, so when the module is awaited or returned from an async function, the runner calls `then(resolve, reject)`. Your `then` returns its argument without ever calling `resolve`, so the promise never settles and the run hangs. This looks like a real problem in how Vitest handles such modules, since native ESM handles it differently. Note that I couldn't search existing issues or the source in this session, so I haven't checked for duplicates or confirmed the exact cause. Could you confirm the hang also happens with `vitest --pool=threads` or `--pool=forks`, and share the Vitest version where it last worked, if any? A maintainer will need to confirm.
